read: the close fell 5.43% from saturday 3 october to saturday 10 october, after 9.98% the week before, and still sits 12.59% above the 50 week average, the 4th close above that line in a row and in the 49 weeks it exists in our series, which starts on 24 november 2024. a week earlier the gap was 17.88%. hashrate read 362.36 PH/s on saturday 10 october, the highest of the 56 days in our own log since 13 august 2026, and averaged 339.06 PH/s from 4 to 10 october, against 343.92 PH/s from 27 september to 3 october.
